author: EmuCore - Hub
title: EmuCore V SOLUCIONA GRAFICOS de VITA3K ANDROID 🤯 v.0.0.8
summary: A focused Spanish comparison of EmuCoreV graphics fixes in Gravity Rush and Uncharted, including the remaining shader, resolution and stability problems.

blocks.text: TreppeX tests EmuCoreV 0.0.8 on Snapdragon devices and compares scenes that had visible Vita3K Android rendering faults. Gravity Rush shows cleaner textures after shaders settle, while Uncharted: Golden Abyss loses some persistent top- and bottom-screen artifacts. The video also notes that newly compiled shaders can still flash and that freezes or noisy stalls remain possible.

The presenter does not turn those improvements into a blanket compatibility claim. Increasing resolution can make Uncharted’s artifacts more visible, and parts of the game remain not fully playable. That combination of fixed visuals and unresolved progression issues is exactly why screenshots, resolution, driver and scene must all be recorded when reporting an emulator graphics improvement.
